description: SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE Project No. 865CM3033 Nashville National Cemetery FCA Deficiency Corrections Madison, Tennessee The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), National Cemetery Administration (NCA), is conducting market research to identify qualified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSBs) capable of performing construction services for FCA deficiency corrections at Nashville National Cemetery, Madison, Tennessee. NAICS Code: 236220, Commercial and Institutional Building Construction The project includes building renovations, historic restoration and preservation, hazardous material abatement, demolition, electrical upgrades, ADA improvements, paving repairs, fencing and gate repairs, signage replacement, monument repairs, masonry restoration, and related site work. Interested SDVOSB firms shall provide the following information: Company Name UEI CAGE Code Confirmation of SDVOSB certification status Single-project bonding capacity Two (2) projects completed within the last five (5) years demonstrating experience with similar scope and complexity. For each project provide: Project title Customer/Agency Final contract value Brief description of work performed Indicate whether your firm has experience with: Historic building restoration/preservation Lead-based paint and asbestos abatement Construction within active cemeteries, military installations, or similarly sensitive environments An affirmative statement that your firm is interested in this requirement and intends to submit an offer if a solicitation is issued. Interested SDVOSB firms shall submit responses via email to Daniel P. Kinney, Contract Specialist, at daniel.kinney@va.gov, no later than 11/05/2026. The subject line shall read: "Sources Sought Response � Project No. 865CM3033 � Nashville National Cemetery FCA Deficiency Corrections." Responses shall be limited to two (2) pages and address only the information requested in this notice. Do not submit generic capability statements, company marketing materials, brochures, or other promotional information. The Government is seeking specific information demonstrating relevant experience, qualifications, bonding capacity, and intent to compete for this requirement. Responses that do not address the requested information may not be considered in the market research assessment. This Sources Sought Notice is for market research purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation or commitment by the Government. The Government will use responses to determine the availability of qualified SDVOSB concerns and the appropriate acquisition strategy.
